all.name: surface_elements
all.description: The interactive elements of the page in a browser surface (role, name and box in surface pixels), to aim clicks.

all.name: surface_list
all.description: List the surfaces open in the app (browser tabs, documents, VMs) with their uri, size and mode.

all.name: surface_navigate
all.description: Load a URL in a browser surface and wait for it. Returns the new URL and title.

all.name: surface_open_browser
all.description: Open a new browser tab at a URL. The user sees it in the Surfaces panel. Returns its surface uri.

all.name: surface_page_text
all.description: The URL, title and readable text of the page in a browser surface.

all.name: surface_screenshot
all.description: Capture the surface as a PNG image.

all.name: surface_scroll
all.description: Scroll at a point of the surface. Positive dy scrolls the content down.

all.name: surface_type
all.description: Type text into the focused element of the surface.
